SLL.Title: Loot Ledger
SLL.NotReady: The Loot Ledger is not set up yet. It sets itself up as soon as a GM is online.
SLL.NoGM: No GM is online. Changes need a GM, you can still look around.
SLL.Heavy: Too heavy for your character to carry

Stash.title: Party inventory
Stash.addFund: Add coins to the party fund
Stash.dropHint: Drop items from your character sheet here to put them into the party inventory.

Pool.title: Loot to share
Pool.removeConfirm: Remove {name} for good? The log keeps a note of it.
Pool.dropHint: Drop items from sheets, the sidebar, compendiums or loot links here.

distributeConfirm.fair: Hand out all claimed loot: among the strongest claims the character who received the least so far gets it, a roll breaks ties. Loot nobody wants goes into the party inventory.
distributeConfirm.roll: Hand out all claimed loot: among the strongest claims the highest roll wins. Loot nobody wants goes into the party inventory.
distributeConfirm.gm: You hand out the loot yourself. This only moves the loot nobody wants into the party inventory.

Pool.off: The loot table is switched off. Hand out what is left or move it into the party inventory.

from.stash: {what} from {from} added to the party inventory
from.fund: {what} from {from} added to the party fund

create.pool: {what} put into the loot outside the module
create.stash: {what} put into the party inventory outside the module

delete.pool: {what} removed from the loot outside the module
delete.stash: {what} removed from the party inventory outside the module

edit.update: Quantity of {name} changed outside the module: {old} → {new}

Log.pageIntro: Kept by the Loot Ledger. Only the GM's client writes here, and any later change shows up in the module's check.
Log.intact: Log intact: {count} entries, none changed afterwards.
Log.undoConfirm: Reverse this entry? Items and coins go back where they came from, and the log records the undo.

Reason.fairRoll: received the least so far, rolled

Balance.hint: What each character took from the loot, the party inventory and the party fund, minus what they put in. Gifts between characters count for the one who receives them.

Dialog.splitHint: The coins go in equal shares to the characters you pick. What cannot be shared goes into the party fund.
Dialog.splitHintPool: The coins go in equal shares to the characters you pick. What cannot be split stays in the loot.

CoinValues.intro: Worth of one coin in {coin}, the smallest coin. Coins already in the loot and the party fund keep their worth in {coin}.
CoinValues.invalid: Every coin needs a whole number of at least 1.

Collect.title: Collect from the fight
Collect.hint: Pick what the defeated leave behind. It moves into the loot, and the log notes where it came from.
Collect.hintStash: Pick what the defeated leave behind. It goes into the party inventory, and the log notes where it came from.

Notice.waitingApproval: Your request waits for the GM.
Notice.distributed: {count} items handed out, {rest} moved to the party inventory.
Notice.nothingToCollect: The defeated have nothing to leave behind.
Notice.collectedStash: {count} things put into the party inventory.

Error.requestFailed: That did not work. See the console for details.
Error.unknownSender: The request could not be checked.
Error.noStorage: The party inventory does not exist yet. A GM sets it up on login.
Error.notYours: You can only act for your own characters.
Error.gmOnly: Only the GM can do that.
Error.itemGone: That item is no longer there.
Error.noCoins: This system has no coins the module can use. The GM can name them in the module settings.
Error.noCoinsToSplit: There are no coins in the loot.
Error.tooFewCoins: Too few coins to give everyone something.
Error.nothingToDistribute: Nothing to hand out: no item has a claim yet.
Error.nothingUnclaimed: Every item of the loot has a claim.
Error.cannotUndo: This entry cannot be undone anymore.
Error.dropOwn: Drop items from your own character here.
Error.lootOff: The loot table is switched off.
Error.fundOff: The party fund is switched off.

Block.cursed: Cursed and invested: only the GM can take it off.
Block.equippedInCombat: Equipped during a fight: unequip it first.

uiLanguage.name: Module language
uiLanguage.hint: Language of the Loot Ledger for you. Follow Foundry uses Foundry's language.

lootTable.name: Loot table
lootTable.hint: Players claim loot (need, want, pass) and the GM hands it out. Off: the Loot Ledger is just a party inventory. Nothing is collected after a fight, the GM collects by hand and hands things out from the party inventory.

partyFund.name: Party fund
partyFund.hint: Shared coins of the group. Off: coins stay with the characters. Coins already in the fund can still be taken out.

balanceTab.name: Balance tab
balanceTab.hint: Shows what each character took from the group and put in.

recipients.name: Who shares the loot
recipients.hint: The characters who can claim loot and get coins from a split.
recipients.party: The system's party, otherwise all player characters

stashWithdraw.name: Taking from the party inventory
stashWithdraw.hint: Whether players can simply take items or need the GM's approval. Putting things in is always free.

fundLimit.name: Party fund limit
fundLimit.hint: Players can take up to this amount (in the system's main coin) from the party fund without asking. More needs the GM's approval. 0 means always ask.

giveAcceptance.name: Gifts must be accepted
giveAcceptance.hint: When a character gives something to another player's character, that player accepts or declines first.

distribution.name: How loot is handed out
distribution.hint: What happens when the GM hands out the claimed loot.
distribution.fair: Fair: the strongest claim, then who received the least so far
distribution.roll: Roll: the strongest claim, then the highest roll

remainder.name: Rest of a coin split
remainder.hint: Where the coins go that cannot be shared evenly.

collectPrompt.name: Offer to collect after a fight
collectPrompt.hint: When a combat ends, the GM is asked what the defeated leave behind.

chatCards.name: Chat messages
chatCards.hint: A chat message for every change. The log in the journal is there either way.

genericCharacterType.name: Actor type of player characters
genericCharacterType.hint: For systems without built in support: the actor type of player characters, several separated by commas.

genericQuantity.name: Where items keep their quantity
genericQuantity.hint: For systems without built in support, for example system.quantity.

genericPrice.name: Where items keep their price
genericPrice.hint: For systems without built in support, a number in coins, for example system.price. Leave empty if there is none.

genericCurrency.name: Where characters keep their coins
genericCurrency.hint: For systems without built in support, a single number, for example system.currency. Leave empty to switch the coin features off.

genericCoinName.name: Name of the coin
genericCoinName.hint: For systems without built in support, the short name shown after amounts.

coinValues.name: Coin values
coinValues.label: Set coin values
coinValues.hint: What each coin is worth, for tables with their own exchange rates. Coins you leave unchanged use the rates of the system.

SELFTEST.Title: Loot Ledger self test
SELFTEST.Hint: Checks the party inventory, the log and the connection to your game system. Run it after an update of Foundry or the system.
SELFTEST.Passed: Self test passed: {checks} checks, system support {system}.
SELFTEST.Problems: Self test: {problems} of {checks} checks failed. See the chat message.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: The Loot Ledger was verified with older versions than {versions}. Run the self test in the module settings to check that everything still works.
SELFTEST.NoActor: The party inventory actor is missing.
SELFTEST.ActorOwnership: Players cannot see the party inventory actor. Give everyone at least observer rights.
SELFTEST.ActorOwner: Players own the party inventory actor and could change it past the log. Observer rights are enough.
SELFTEST.NoJournal: The loot log journal is missing.
SELFTEST.JournalOwnership: Players cannot read the loot log. Give everyone at least observer rights.
SELFTEST.Chain: The log was changed afterwards ({count} entries checked).
SELFTEST.Query: Requests to the GM are not registered.
SELFTEST.Generic: {system} has no built in support. The module uses the paths from its settings.
SELFTEST.CruciblePhysical: Crucible's item model was not found.
SELFTEST.Coins: The system's coins could not be read.
SELFTEST.StashType: The system has no group actor type for the party inventory.
SELFTEST.Containers: Containers cannot be handed over with their contents.
SELFTEST.CharacterType: The actor type of player characters from the settings does not exist.
SELFTEST.QuantityPath: Items have no quantity at the path from the settings.
